lots.working: Keep: same-item kits in similar form are the Gowans X-300 kit ($155) and the near-twin XG-M kit with two zooms ($120). The XG-1 box ($40) and the Elite UK X-300 (about $40, one lens only, no zoom, flash or bag) are lesser kits, so not used as the floor, though they show the downside. Lowest similar-kit SOLD = $120; $120 / 1.22 = $98.36, round down to $95. Flip: likely resale about $130 hammer (midpoint of $120-155 SOLD); selling via a local auction with 15% commission ($19.50) and $0 postage, or eBay with about 13% fee plus $15 postage, nets about $98-110. Take $98 / 2.44 = $40.16, round down to $40. Flip margin is thin, so KEEP not BOTH.
lots.confidence_reason: Model names read in the photos (X-300 on body, MC Zoom Rokkor 80-200mm f4.5 on lens) and one same-model Tasmanian SOLD kit plus one near-twin, both opened with photos viewed. Working order unknown, and cheaper results ($35-40) show real downside risk.
